items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: He said, I heard so much about you. He said, I'd love to hear you play.

ctx.x: I can't think of his name. Very fine piano man.

He said, I heard so much about you. He said, I'd love to hear you play. I said, well, I don't play like you. I play like me. He says, that's why I want to hear you, because I heard so many fine things about the way the solid piano player that you are. So Dick Johnson asked me, does he play? So he says, come on and sit in and play a couple of tunes. So I played three tunes and sang black and blue. And they seemed to be very happy with it. Sidney Snow was playing bass.
